newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House Democrat opposes budget plan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House Democrat opposes budget plan.

text.p: Democratic Rep. David Obey on Thursday called the reported balanced budget plan "let's pretend deficit reduction" and told reporters many Democrats were ready to vote against it.

While details have not yet been presented to Democrats, he said some members of his party was particularly concerned that proposed tax cuts would balloon in the five years after 2002, worsening the federal budget deficit.
"I think a lot of (Democratic) members will be opposed to this package," the liberal Wisconsin lawmaker said. "They will be clamoring to bring it down,"
Obey is the senior Democrat on the House Appropriations Committee.
